Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) workflow using endogenous FANCA as bait. While phosphorylation was listed as a variable modification in the search parameters, there was no specific phospho-enrichment step (like TiO2 or IMAC); the enrichment was based on the FANCA protein complex. Therefore, mod_ap_ms is the primary modifier.

scope: Identification and analysis of FANCA interacting proteins in 293FT, EndoC-βH3 and MiaPaCa-2 cells was done using Dynabeads Antibody Coupling Kit (ThermoFisher).
Anti-FANCA antibodies (60 μg) (Bethyl Laboratories) were coupled onto magnetic beads (3 mg) at 37 ºC overnight, with rotation.
To elute the bound protein fraction, beads were incubated with 500 μL 0.5 M NH4OH/0.5 mM EDTA, pH 11.0, for 10 min with rotation.
endogenous FANCA was immunoprecipitated from EndoC-βH3 cells that were cultured in either 5 mM or 20 mM glucose (Fig 3A).
